commit: a7815ff (plan11 final; plan12/plan13 make no src/ changes)
build: cargo build --release (plan11/plan12 product binary, reused; no rebuild needed)
epsilon: arm-dimension: base = 0.125 (default, no flag), e375 = --epsilon 0.375, e5 = --epsilon 0.5 (D2: single-option change per arm)
mode: first-outcome, --outcome-only, via the product CLI (atomic_solver --salt S --budget C --timeout 600 [--epsilon E])
corpus: 22 cases (frozen plan12 corpus) x 6 salts {0,1,2,3,4,5} x 3 arms = 396 runs; the baseline arm is run fresh (never copied from plan12) so its cells double as the D3(a)/(b) cross-session identity audit
caps: child-eval budget via --budget: stress 2,500,000,000; m20_white 2,000,000,000; all others 1,000,000,000; wall-clock secondary cap --timeout 600 s
salt_definition: --salt s>0 remaps the TT bucket index to ((key ^ s) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 >> 17) & mask; salt 0 keeps shipped key & mask (bit-identical); full-key verification unchanged for all salts
concurrency: up to 3 solver processes in parallel; the budgeted first-outcome search is deterministic per (FEN, salt, epsilon), so only wall_s is affected

gates.D3a_salt0_identity: fresh baseline salt-0 cells must reproduce the plan11/plan12 recorded values exactly: stress 249,480,478; m22 14,156,269; m23 9,673,403; dec13 3,822,602; dec10 4,262,128; m20 censored at 2 B (degenerate null: any mismatch is an identity failure, not noise)
gates.D3b_baseline_persalt: the fresh baseline arm must equal plan12's recorded per-salt value (evals AND censoring status) on all 22 cases x 6 salts
gates.D3c_outcome: zero decisive-outcome conflicts within any arm across salts; every uncensored run of every arm matches its fixture expected outcome (epsilon changes work, never the proven value)
gates.D3d_censored_draw: a budget-censored draw is the no-result sentinel, never a proven draw; censored runs enter no outcome set

notes: Raw transcripts (*.out, *.err, *.meta.json under RAW=/tmp/plan13/results) are not committed; driver.py regenerates them deterministically.

Verdicts per gate_methodology.md v1.0 (pinned): per-salt paired ratios, W_LO 0.9 / W_HI 1.1 + >=75% direction agreement, censored-win/loss classes, hard class = stress/m20/m22/m23, under-budget rule > 3 of 6, low-diversity basins cannot solely support an adopt.
The observed paired-ratio dispersion recorded here is the pinned comparison rule's first real-arm calibration data point (methodology standing rule: any W_LO/W_HI revision needs stated data).
